items.title: Base change of the sections with support along a flat ring map, and the bounded case when the rings have finite dimension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement asserts that for a flat map of Noetherian rings the base change of the derived sections with support in a specialization-stable subset is the derived sections with support in its inverse image, for bounded below complexes, and for all complexes when both rings have finite dimension (author lemma at source lines 1098-1111, label lemma-torsion-change-rings). The proof (source lines 1113-1128) first constructs the arrow and checks that its source is supported in the inverse image, then disposes of the case of a closed support by the base change statement of the chapter on dualizing complexes, and finally reduces the general support to that case by expressing the local cohomology with support in a general subset as a filtered colimit over the closed subsets it contains, as recalled in the context span; flatness makes the base change commute with these colimits (proof lines 1120-1127). The colimit reduction to the closed case is the content. H2.
